detail.longDescription:
Airswitch is a VPN focused on connection speed and reliable server infrastructure.

Connect to a VPN server in your preferred location and manage your connection through a simple interface. The app is designed for users who value fast connection times, clear server selection, and stable network performance.

Features:
— Fast VPN connection
— Server infrastructure built for reliable performance
— Available location selection
— Connection status display
— Simple interface without unnecessary settings

Connection speed and quality may depend on your network, the distance to the server, the selected location, and current server load.

For more information about data collection and processing, please refer to the app’s Privacy Policy.
